changelog:
v4.0.1 — Live TV Cursor Fix

• Coming back from fullscreen Live TV now puts the highlight right back on the channel you were watching — no more invisible cursor and blind D-pad presses.
• The category list highlight is now clearly visible even when it sits on the category that's already selected.

Includes everything from v4.0.0: the new TV Guide, seamless binge episode transitions, and the playback polish pack.
